english.title: Use on a road a bus as a school bus when there was not fitted to the vehicle a school bus sign
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a bus, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), carrying a child to or from school when there was not fitted to the

(A)_[front of the bus and plainly visible to road users ahead of the bus]_
(B)_[rear of the bus and plainly visible to road users behind the bus]_

english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 17A of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
